items.question: I have Rs 9,500 in basic wallet and want to add Rs 1,000 more. Also how do I make it full KYC and then send wallet money back to my bank?
items.reference_answer: A basic wallet can hold only up to Rs 10,000, so Rs 9,500 + Rs 1,000 would exceed the limit by Rs 500. To upgrade, go to Wallet > Upgrade KYC and complete video verification with Aadhaar and PAN; approval is usually within 24 hours. To send wallet money to your bank, use Wallet > Send to bank; it arrives within 30 minutes with no fee.

items.question: Kal maine Rs 150 ka mobile recharge kiya aur electricity bill wallet se pay kiya. Dono pe charges lagenge kya?
items.reference_answer: Yes. A mobile recharge above Rs 100 has a Rs 2 platform fee, and paying a bill from the wallet adds a Rs 3 convenience fee. So the fees are Rs 2 for the recharge and Rs 3 for the bill.

items.question: I added my bank account 10 hours ago. Can I send Rs 8,000 in one shot, or Rs 4,000 now and Rs 4,000 later today?
items.reference_answer: No, not during the first 24 hours after adding a bank account. New users can send up to Rs 5,000 per day in that period, so Rs 8,000 total today is not allowed. A single transaction can be up to Rs 50,000, but the new user daily limit is lower here.

items.question: I already made 19 successful payments today totaling Rs 96,000. Can I do two more payments of Rs 2,000 each before midnight?
items.reference_answer: No. You have only one successful transaction left today because the daily count limit is 20. You also have Rs 4,000 left under the Rs 1,00,000 daily amount limit, so only one more payment up to Rs 4,000 can be made before midnight.

items.question: I changed my phone number and also got a new bank account. How do I get PayLoom working with the new number and add that account?
items.reference_answer: First update the new number with your bank. Then log in to the app with the new number and verify by SMS to link your accounts again. To add another account, go to Settings > Add bank account, choose your bank and verify by SMS; the number must be registered with that bank account.

items.question: My UPI PIN got blocked after I typed it wrong 3 times, but I also do not remember the PIN now. Should I wait or reset it?
items.reference_answer: After 3 wrong attempts, the PIN is blocked for 24 hours. You can wait 24 hours, or reset it right away with Forgot UPI PIN. For reset, enter the last 6 digits and expiry date of your debit card, the bank OTP, and set a new PIN.

items.question: I added SBI account in app but no UPI PIN yet. Where to set it, and if I add my HDFC account also what verification is needed?
items.reference_answer: For the newly added account, tap Set UPI PIN, enter the debit card last 6 digits and expiry date, enter the bank OTP, and create a 4 or 6 digit PIN. To add another bank account, go to Settings > Add bank account, choose the bank and verify by SMS. The mobile number must be the one registered with that bank account.

items.question: Need my payment records: last 18 months, plus FY annual statement for tax. Where can I download, and what if I need older than 24 months?
items.reference_answer: For statements, go to Profile > Statements, choose the period up to 12 months and tap Download; the PDF is also emailed. The annual statement for the financial year is under Profile > Statements > Annual from 15 April. The app shows only the last 24 months of transactions, so older transactions are not shown in the app.

items.question: I referred 12 friends this month. 9 already made Rs 100 payments, 1 made Rs 50, and 2 have not paid yet. How many referral rewards can I get now?
items.reference_answer: You earn only when a friend completes a first payment of at least Rs 100 within 30 days of joining. Right now 9 friends qualify, so you and those friends get Rs 100 each. The monthly reward cap is 10 referrals, so only one more qualifying referral can earn this month.

items.question: My cashback scratch card came 16 days ago and I also made a payment 30 hours ago. When will cashback come, and can I still open that old scratch card?
items.reference_answer: A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it, so a 16-day-old card has expired. Cashback from a payment is credited to your wallet within 48 hours. Since it has been 30 hours, it can still arrive within the normal time.

items.question: Merchant says refund was approved 6 working days ago, and another refund was approved 9 working days ago but no money. What should I do for both?
items.reference_answer: After merchant approval, a refund reaches your bank account in 5 to 7 working days. The 6-working-day refund is still within the normal window. For the 9-working-day refund, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the refund reference number from the merchant.

items.question: A store charged me twice for same order today. I want proof for both payments also. What is the reversal time and how do I get receipts?
items.reference_answer: A duplicate charge for the same order is normally reversed automatically within 3 working days. If the extra amount is not reversed after 3 working days, raise a dispute with both transaction IDs. For receipts, open each transaction in History and tap Share receipt to get a PDF or image.

items.question: I scanned a shop QR and paid Rs 2,500 instead of Rs 250. The shop is not replying for 8 days. Is this a fraud report or some other complaint?
items.reference_answer: For paying more than the bill amount by mistake in a QR payment, ask the merchant to refund the extra amount because a completed payment cannot be changed. Since the merchant has not responded within 7 days, raise a dispute in Help > Payments. If you think you were cheated in a fraud payment, also use Help > Report fraud and contact your bank immediately.

items.question: Phone chori ho gaya. I had app lock disabled. What can I do now to stop PayLoom use and what should I enable next time?
items.reference_answer: From another phone, log in with your number and tap Deregister old device. Also call your bank to block UPI on your account and your SIM provider to block the SIM. Next time, you can enable Settings > Security > App lock and choose fingerprint, face or a screen PIN.

items.question: Unknown aadmi sent me a collect request saying enter UPI PIN to receive Rs 5,000. Should I approve it, and is there any charge to receive/send to friends?
items.reference_answer: Decline the request. You never need to enter your UPI PIN to receive money, so a request asking for your PIN is a scam; report it in Help > Report fraud. Sending money to friends and family from your bank account is free.

items.question: If I add Rs 5,000 to wallet using credit card, what fee applies? Also how can I add wallet money from my bank instead?
items.reference_answer: Adding money to the wallet with a credit card has a 2 percent fee. For Rs 5,000, 2 percent is Rs 100. To add money from your bank account, go to Wallet > Add money, enter the amount and pay using your UPI PIN; adding from a bank account is free.

items.question: I want HDFC to be default but also remove my old ICICI account. There is one pending payment on ICICI. What should I do?
items.reference_answer: To make HDFC default, go to Settings > Bank accounts, open HDFC and tap Set as default. To remove ICICI, go to Settings > Bank accounts, open it and tap Remove. Finish any pending payments first; removing only unlinks the account from the app and does not close the bank account.

items.question: One payment failed yesterday and money was deducted, another payment was declined today but no debit happened. What are the next steps for both?
items.reference_answer: For the failed payment with money deducted, it is reversed automatically to your bank account within 3 working days. If it is not back after 3 working days, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the transaction ID. For the declined payment with no deduction, check your balance, limit and UPI PIN and try again; if it keeps failing, contact your bank.

items.question: My rent payment is pending and amount debited since 3 hours. Another payment shows success but receiver says not received. Should I pay again?
items.reference_answer: Do not pay again for the pending payment. A pending payment is either completed or reversed within 24 hours; if it is still pending after 24 hours, raise a dispute in Help > Payments. For the successful payment, share the UTR with the receiver and raise a dispute if it is not credited within 2 working days.

items.question: I sent Rs 30,000 to the wrong UPI ID today. Also I need to send Rs 60,000 to the correct person now. What are my options?
items.reference_answer: For the wrong transfer, raise a Wrong Transfer complaint in Help > Payments within 7 days and contact your bank; PayLoom cannot reverse a completed payment itself. A single transaction can be up to Rs 50,000, so Rs 60,000 cannot be sent in one payment. Since the daily limit is Rs 1,00,000 and Rs 30,000 is already sent, you have Rs 70,000 left today, so split Rs 60,000 into more than one payment.
